segments.en: The mishna cited Rabbi Meir’s statement: «At the» breaks between «paragraphs, one may greet» an individual due to the respect that he is obligated to show him, and may respond. And in the middle of each paragraph, one may greet an individual due to the fear that the individual may harm him if he fails do so, and may respond.
